title: Wall-slam batch F — Area Tasks, fairy rings, POH, Edgeville, elite outfits
sourceReview: user batch: Area Tasks diaries ownership; Fairy ring Misthalin (+Morytania ok); POH gilded marble/gold leaf Frem OR Tir OR Forinthry; POH portals idk; Edgeville Misthalin+Forinthry boundary; Elite outfits Farming beans Kandarin / Warped Gorajan Forinthry / Hunter Anachronia
policy: Catalog is read-only this pass — record rulings only; do not edit data/research/catalog.json from this file alone.
confidence high|medium decisions are apply-ready for wall-slam-apply-high.mjs keepHosts/primary/remove.

decisions.name: Area Tasks (achievement diaries) skilling overview
decisions.ruling: multi-ok all diary regions; indicate per-region diary ownership
decisions.detailPatch: Achievement diaries / Area Tasks are region-scoped. Each host owns only its own diary (Misthalin, Karamja, Asgarnia, Kandarin, Fremennik, Forinthry/Wilderness, Desert, Morytania, Tirannwn as published). Multi-ok on every diary region so the planner can surface the diary that matches a pick — not a single global route and not an all-regions AND gate. Pick the region that owns the diary rewards you care about.
decisions.note: Do not collapse to one home. Do not treat requiredRegions as a 9-pick combo.

decisions.name: Fairy ring network (Zanaris hub)
decisions.ruling: Misthalin primary; Morytania ok as secondary host
decisions.detailPatch: Zanaris / fairy-ring hub taxonomy is Misthalin. Keep multi-ok on Misthalin + Morytania (rings and approaches that sit on the Morytania side are fine to surface there). Hard region pressure for the network package is Misthalin — Morytania is multi-ok host, not a second mandatory pick.

decisions.name: POH gilded altar (Chapel offering)
decisions.ruling: marble block / gold leaf materials = Fremennik OR Tirannwn OR Forinthry
decisions.detailPatch: POH gilded altar material pressure is marble block / gold leaf from Fremennik OR Tirannwn OR Forinthry (any one). Multi-ok hosts are those three material regions — not an AND of all three. Altar is usable in any house instance once built; do not hard-require Misthalin as a material gate. Fort Forinthry chapel remains a separate Fort prayer surface.
decisions.note: Drop misthalin from hosts/requiredRegions as material owner. Apply script cannot encode OR — leave requiredRegions as the three material ids with semantics any_one so a later clamp can rewrite.

decisions.name: Edgeville skilling and Wilderness on-ramp hub
decisions.detailPatch: Edgeville town / bank / skilling approach is Misthalin; Wilderness content north of the ditch is Forinthry. Multi-ok both hosts with requiredRegions=[misthalin,forinthry] as a boundary package. Do not pull Asgarnia. Do not claim Abyss as Misthalin-owned — only Edgeville approach logistics on the Misthalin side.
decisions.note: Answers wave2-walls Edgeville question: multi-ok misthalin+forinthry (not single-home Misthalin-only, not Asgarnia host).

decisions.name: Elite skilling outfits core set (ironman fragment paths)
decisions.ruling: Farming beans Kandarin; Warped Gorajan Forinthry; Elite Hunter Anachronia
decisions.detailPatch: Core elite-outfit region pressure for this portfolio row: Elite Farming (beans path) → Kandarin; Warped Gorajan trailblazer pieces → Forinthry/Wilderness; Elite Hunter → Anachronia. Multi-ok only those three hosts with requiredRegions matching. Prefer individual equipment rows for effects. Secondary fragment geographies (Desert / Tirannwn / Fremennik / Asgarnia) are not hosts on this core set — leave them on per-outfit equipment rows if needed.
decisions.note: Shrink hosts from prior 7-host fan to the three user-named cores.

decisions.name: Player-owned house portal towns and Construction utilities
decisions.question: POH portal towns remain product-open. Portal exits are multi-region geography; the house instance is not region-owned; Rimmington is the usual Construction supply default. Choose one before catalog surgery: (A) multi-ok on all portal-town hosts with full requiredRegions (current fan — implies all towns matter as picks), (B) primary-only asgarnia (Rimmington) with other destinations as detail only, (C) per-region local portal rows without all_required AND, (D) global remove as non-upgrade convenience / not a region lock. User has not picked A–D.
decisions.note: Do not apply keepHosts/primary/remove until the question is answered. Prior apply-user-foreign-rulings C2 left multi hosts with an explicit idk note.
